test_vectors.execution: Not run. The task prohibits compiler, build, check, formatting, and test commands. Review was by source inspection only.
test_vectors.fixture_strategy: Private, statically dispatched SlotAccess and FromSlot implementations let unproven fixtures exercise the same decoding and plan-validation algorithms used by every public wrapper. No ValidationProof is constructed or fabricated. Fixture span resolvers model the frozen reader contract; their tests verify decoder delegation and propagation, not the root reader implementation itself.
coverage_limitations: The crate forbids unsafe code, and the allowed dependencies expose no safe producer of ValidationProof. Public validate_slots owner-length and fingerprint gates therefore have source review, not executable fixture coverage in this module. They delegate directly to SlotReader::new before inspecting the plan.
Allocation failure is handled with try_reserve_exact and BudgetExhausted but is not forced by a nondeterministic allocator-exhaustion test.
Compilation and execution of all inline tests remain unverified because the user explicitly prohibited those commands.

status.integration: Uses frozen ABI and root AOT types only. Production slot access, string resolution, raw resolution, owner-length validation, and fingerprint validation delegate to SlotReader. No later-wave module is required by this implementation; other declared modules still need their assigned implementations for eventual crate-wide compilation.
notes: Only crates/jmax-schema-aot/src/decode.rs and this handoff report were written.
Read the frozen AOT contract, AOT root, ABI root and relevant ABI definitions, and the prior-wave tables implementation before writing source.

Plan validation checks exact dense index coverage and unique full-width field IDs before processing values in caller order. Scratch allocation is fallible, comparisons are O(n log n), and scratch storage is O(n).

Individual decoders allocate no storage, enforce exact types and requiredness, check integer narrowing and finite floats, preserve decimal representation, and attach Decode field context without losing resolver offsets or details.
No proofs are issued or strengthened, no raw JSON-validity claims are made, and no unsafe code or forbidden dependencies are used.
No compiler, build/check/test, formatter, or commit command was run.
